shortDescription: Collect facts from remote devices running MikroTik RouterOS

options.name: gather_subset
options.description: When supplied, this argument will restrict the facts collected to a given subset. Possible values for this argument include V(all), V(hardware), V(config), V(interfaces), and V(routing). Can specify a list of values to include a larger subset. Values can also be used with an initial V(!) to specify that a specific subset should not be collected.
